\caption{\textbf{FLUX.1-Krea-dev transformer at $4096^2$.} Two prompts sampled uniformly from all 100 four-method evaluation prompts, without selection by visual quality or metric score. Each prompt occupies two rows: full images, then matching native-pixel crops. Seed 0, 28 steps, guidance 4.5, with FLUX.1-dev text encoders and VAE. SCA is recalibrated for Krea; DyPE and SEGA use the earlier Krea campaign with the recorded source repairs. This compares the recorded implementations under the shared sampling settings, rather than each method's separately tuned defaults or equal runtime. The inherited baselines span multiple recorded runtime revisions. 7 SEGA outputs were regenerated from an archived runtime to replace historical outputs whose exact source snapshots could not be recovered. Crop locations maximize edge energy averaged across the methods shown. Prompt selection uses seed 17; source hashes and crop coordinates are archived with the figure.}
